name: alisareactionbot
description: A Telegram Bot that automatically reacts to posts in Telegram Channels, groups, and private messages, developed as a serverless application.

BOT_TOKEN.description: The Telegram bot token (Generate from BotFather)

BOT_USERNAME.description: The username you have set for your bot.

EMOJI_LIST.description: A string of emojis that the bot will use to react to messages.

RANDOM_LEVEL.description: Reaction randomness for groups (0-10). 0 = always, 10 = rarely.

RESTRICTED_CHATS.description: A list of chat IDs where the bot should not react to messages (Optional)

OWNER_ID.description: Telegram user ID for owner-only commands (/broadcast, /log, /leave, /chats). Get from @userinfobot.

WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Secret token for webhook validation. Auto-generated if not set.

BOT_PHOTO.description: Photo URL or Telegram file_id for bot messages (/start, /help, etc).

PORT.description: Port to run the app on
